contract: You are a trader in a research study. Given market data, place exactly one bracket trade like a discretionary trader: choose a direction, a stop-loss distance and a take-profit distance from the entry price (entry = the most recent close in the data). The trade will then run untouched until the stop or the target is hit — you never get to adjust it. Respond with ONLY a JSON object, no other text: {"action": "long" | "short" | "flat", "stop_loss_pct": <percent number>, "take_profit_pct": <percent number>, "confidence": <number 0 to 1>, "reason": "<at most 20 words>"}. Percent numbers are percent of entry price (2.5 means 2.5%). If action is "flat", use 0 for both distances.
exclusion_policy: Before scoring: exclude any external data access, incomplete text/image delivery, wrong model/effort, or invalid output. Preserve attempts; fresh replacement. No P/L-based retries.
